title: 河道分洪工程~River flood-diversion works
focus: 從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析~Floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects
summary: 課程把分洪入口、渠段、收縮、尾水及重匯流視為同一系統，逐步計算流量、比能、臨界水深、波速與泥砂收支，再檢查高程餘量及數值解析度。紅河與元朗是已核對的實際工程背景，所有算例均為原創假設，並非這兩處的操作門檻或斷面設計。~The course treats inlet, channel, contraction, tailwater and rejoining reach as one system, calculating discharge, specific energy, critical depth, wave speed and sediment budgets before checking elevation margins and numerical resolution. Red River and Yuen Long are verified project contexts. All numerical examples are original assumptions rather than their operating thresholds or section designs.

units.anchor: 分流控制體與受益範圍~Diversion control volume and effects
units.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證~Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。局部水位降低可能伴隨上游回水或出口負荷增加，跨區影響不能藏在模型邊界外；分流比例是水位、構造物和支路阻力共同求得的結果，而不是永遠固定的設計百分比。本例只作瞬時水量連續，假設分流節點沒有蓄水或其他支路；不由此推定任何河段水位或可接受的影響分配。~A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. Local stage reduction may accompany upstream backwater or greater outlet loading, and transferred effects must not be hidden outside model boundaries. Diversion fraction emerges from levels, structures and branch resistance rather than remaining a fixed design percentage. The example applies instantaneous continuity without junction storage or other branches. It determines neither reach stages nor an acceptable distribution of impacts.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction.
units.verify: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。把主河、繞道與重匯流區列在同一評估邊界，分別比較水位、流量及受影響土地。~Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Include the main river, bypass and rejoining area in one assessment boundary, comparing stage, discharge and affected land separately rather than reporting one local benefit.
units.failure: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。~Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. An unclosed ledger may treat transferred water as flood volume that has disappeared.
units.misconception: 分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。~Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
units.practice: 畫出含重新匯流點的完整控制體，標記每股流量和可能儲水區。說明缺少哪個邊界會讓局部效益被誤認為全流域效益，再檢查合成水量帳。~Draw a complete control volume including the rejoining point, labeling flows and possible storage. Identify a missing boundary that could turn a local benefit into a misleading basin-wide claim, then reconcile the synthetic ledger.

units.anchor: 入口門檻與自由溢流~Inlet threshold and free overflow
units.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證~Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。堰頂以上水頭的非線性關係，使小幅高程誤差可能明顯改變開始分流的時間與比例；實際側向入口、閘門和回水會偏離簡單正面堰，因此計算式應與入口構型一致。本例為理想正面自由矩形堰並指定係數，不描述紅河或元朗實際入口；不將此算式用作現場閘門操作規則。~An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises. Nonlinear dependence on head above crest means small elevation errors can alter diversion timing and share. Real lateral entrances, gates and backwater differ from a simple frontal weir, so the chosen relation must match the actual inlet configuration. The example is an ideal frontal free rectangular weir with a specified coefficient, not the actual Red River or Yuen Long inlet and not a field gate rule.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Diversion Q=17.0 m³/s.
units.verify: 核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。將模型入口類型、係數及有效長度記錄完整，必要時以實體或三維流場試驗驗證側向進流。~Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence. Document inlet type, coefficient and effective length, using physical or three-dimensional flow testing where lateral approach invalidates a simple frontal-weir representation.
units.failure: 把側堰直接當正面堰會忽略沿程水頭變化，門檻高程錯誤也可能造成過早或過晚分流；下游淹沒時沿用自由堰式則通常高估能力。~Treating a side weir as frontal ignores head variation along its length. Incorrect sill elevation can activate diversion too early or late, and retaining a free-weir relation under submergence generally overstates capacity.
units.misconception: 所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。~Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.
units.practice: 畫出正面與側向入口的差異，為同一指定水頭先做理想計算。再列出側向流、淹沒與閘門會新增的資料需求，避免把手算結果當實際分流量。~Draw frontal and lateral inlet differences and perform the ideal calculation at one specified head. List additional information for lateral approach, submergence and gates so that the hand result is not mistaken for actual diversion.

units.anchor: 分洪渠輸水能力~Floodway conveyance capacity
units.title: 分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證~Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分洪道的能力不只取決於寬度，水深、濕周、糙率和能量坡降都會改變輸水量。曼寧式適合穩定均勻流的初步尺度，但入口、橋梁、出口與潮汐回水通常需要非均勻流分析；將地形坡度不加檢查地當成能坡，可能高估平緩河段可提供的驅動水頭。本例為矩形固定斷面且採國際單位的曼寧式，所得不是整條分洪道的保證容量；最窄控制段與回水仍須另算。~Floodway capacity depends on depth, wetted perimeter, roughness and energy slope as well as width. Manning’s equation gives a steady-uniform preliminary scale, while entrances, bridges, outlets and tidal backwater generally need nonuniform analysis. Substituting bed slope for energy slope without checking can overstate the driving head available in a flat reach. The example uses a fixed rectangular section and SI Manning form. It is not guaranteed capacity of the whole floodway; constrictions and backwater require separate analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m. Manning Q=37.49 m³/s.
units.verify: 測量實際斷面、植被與障礙物，核對能坡來自哪個水位區間。用多個流況校驗糙率，並把橋孔及出口控制接入整體模型，避免單段均勻流計算掩蓋系統瓶頸。~Survey actual sections, vegetation and obstructions, identifying the stage interval used to estimate energy slope. Calibrate roughness across several flows and connect bridge and outlet controls to the full model so that one uniform reach does not conceal a system bottleneck.
units.failure: 只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。~Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity. Seasonal vegetation changes effective roughness, and continued use of a clean new-channel value can overstate long-term conveyance.
units.misconception: 分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。~Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.
units.practice: 固定水深和坡降，把糙率提高兩成重算流量，再指出這不是定流量時的水位變化。將入口、橋梁和出口畫成控制鏈，辨認可能先限制能力的位置。~At fixed depth and slope increase roughness by twenty percent and recompute flow, noting that this is not the stage response at fixed discharge. Map inlet, bridge and outlet controls to identify possible governing restrictions.

units.anchor: 臨界水深與控制斷面~Critical depth and control sections
units.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證~Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。臨界條件不等於正常水深，也不直接指出上游水面高程；判斷入口或橋孔是否壅水時，還須比較可用能量、局部損失與兩側邊界，不能只靠水深大小分類。本例為寬度固定的矩形渠、靜水壓分布且動能修正係數取一；複合斷面或強三維入口需其他求解。~For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. Contraction or bed raising can drive a section toward control. Critical depth differs from normal depth and does not directly give upstream elevation; assessing choking also requires available energy, local losses and both boundaries rather than classifying flow from depth alone. The example assumes a fixed-width rectangular channel, hydrostatic pressure and unit energy coefficient. Compound sections or strongly three-dimensional entrances require another solution.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Critical depth yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m.
units.verify: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。以量測流況、下游控制和局部損失檢查可能的水面分支，避免直接把臨界水深填成全河段水位。~Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum. Check possible water-surface branches against observed regime, downstream control and local losses instead of assigning critical depth as the water level throughout the floodway.
units.failure: 把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。~Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. Depth above critical at one section does not prove that the entire system remains subcritical.
units.misconception: 算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。~Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
units.practice: 畫出指定單寬流量的比能曲線，標示可能的兩個水深分支。加入一個底床抬升情境，說明還需要哪些能量資料才能判斷是否發生控制。~Plot specific energy for the given unit discharge and mark the two possible depth branches. Introduce a bed rise and identify the energy information still needed to decide whether choking occurs.

units.anchor: 收縮速度與能量轉換~Contraction velocity and energy change
units.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證~Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。速度水頭增加本身不是摩阻損失，把兩者重複扣除會錯算水面；反之若完全忽略損失，則可能高估可通流量，需要用一致能量線分開表達可逆轉換與耗散。本例只比較動能水頭、兩截面動能修正係數均取一；沒有假定相同底床或已求得水面差，也未包含局部損失。~A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses. Increased velocity head is not itself friction loss, and deducting it twice miscalculates the surface. Ignoring actual loss has the opposite problem, so one energy line must distinguish reversible conversion from dissipation. The example compares kinetic heads with unit energy coefficients only. It does not assume equal bed elevations or determine surface difference, and it excludes local loss.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游v1=1.0 m/s、縮口v2=3.0 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，動能水頭增量Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream v1=1.0 m/s, contracted v2=3.0 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Kinetic-head increase Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m.
units.verify: 把底床、水面和能量線畫在同一剖面，核對速度截面與修正係數。以量測總能量差辨認真正損失，再檢查是否把速度水頭變化同時放入損失項和能量項造成重複扣除。~Plot bed, water surface and energy line on one section, checking velocity sections and correction factors. Identify genuine losses from measured total-energy change, then inspect whether velocity-head conversion has been counted both as an energy term and as a separate loss.
units.failure: 把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。~Calling every surface drop dissipation confuses acceleration with loss and can lead calibration to the wrong coefficient. Omitting local losses makes contraction control optimistic; both errors affect predicted upstream backwater.
units.misconception: 速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。~An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
units.practice: 建立含底高、水深、速度水頭與損失的能量帳，將已知和未知項分開。用兩種假設損失係數比較可用能量，說明速度變化無法單獨決定水面差。~Build an energy ledger with bed elevation, depth, kinetic head and loss, separating knowns from unknowns. Compare available energy under two assumed loss coefficients and explain why velocity change alone cannot determine surface difference.

units.anchor: 回水曲線與下游控制~Backwater profiles and downstream control
units.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證~Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 緩流分洪道的下游水位可向上游影響水深，因此出口河川漲水可能降低分洪效益。漸變流方程把底坡、摩阻坡與福祿數連到局部水深梯度，但接近臨界時分母變小，局部線性外推會不可靠；閘門、跌水和水躍還需另處理，不能跨越不連續流況套同一坡度。本例為稜柱渠的局部漸變流導數，正座標沿下游，水深變化不等於絕對水面高程變化；不作長距離定坡外推。~Downstream stage influences upstream depth in subcritical flow, so rising receiving water can reduce diversion benefit. The gradually varied equation relates bed slope, friction slope and Froude number to local depth gradient. Near critical conditions its denominator becomes small and linear extrapolation becomes unreliable; gates, drops and jumps also need separate treatment rather than one continuous slope. The example is a local gradually varied derivative in a prismatic channel with downstream-positive coordinate. Depth change is not absolute water-surface elevation change, and the slope is not extrapolated over a long reach.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60. Local depth gradient dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m.
units.verify: 確認座標、底坡與水深定義，從適當邊界逐段求解並隨水深更新摩阻和福祿數。用沿程水位資料檢查曲線，接近臨界或存在水躍時改用可處理轉換的分析而非延長局部直線。~Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth. Compare the profile with longitudinal observations and use transition-capable analysis near critical flow or jumps instead of extending a local straight line.
units.failure: 把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。~Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. Coarse steps near critical flow can further magnify numerical instability.
units.misconception: 分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。~A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.
units.practice: 將局部水深坡度與底坡合成絕對水面坡度，再比較不同福祿數下的分母。說明為何需要逐段更新而不能將一點導數乘整條河長。~Combine local depth gradient with bed slope to obtain the absolute surface slope, then compare denominators at different Froude numbers. Explain why reachwise updating is needed instead of multiplying one derivative by the entire channel length.

units.anchor: 洪波傳遞與水團速度~Flood-wave travel and parcel speed
units.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證~Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。對寬矩形均勻曼寧流的運動波近似，可得到流速的特定倍數，但回水、擴散與洪泛區儲存會破壞這個簡化；以距離除平均流速直接估警戒時間可能混淆兩種傳遞。本例採寬矩形、固定坡降與糙率的運動波關係c=5V/3，不用於強回水、閘控或急變洪水；不是實際預警提前量。~A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. A wide rectangular uniform Manning channel yields a particular velocity multiple under a kinematic approximation, but backwater, diffusion and floodplain storage break that simplification. Distance divided by mean velocity can therefore confuse parcel and warning travel times. The example uses c=5V/3 for a wide rectangular kinematic Manning channel with fixed slope and roughness, excluding strong backwater, gate control and abrupt flood transitions. It is not an operational warning lead time.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設平均流速V=1.5 m/s、長度L=5000 m，運動波c=2.5 m/s，傳遞尺度t=L/c=2000 s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume mean velocity V=1.5 m/s and length L=5000 m. Kinematic celerity c=2.5 m/s gives travel scale t=L/c=2000 s.
units.verify: 以多次洪水的上下游歷線估計傳遞與展寬，檢查是否受到尾水或漫地儲存控制。分別標示流速、波速及資料延遲，並比較簡化尺度與完整非恆定演算的適用差異。~Estimate travel and broadening from upstream/downstream hydrographs across several floods, checking tailwater and overbank storage influence. Label flow velocity, wave celerity and data latency separately, and compare the simplified scale with the conditions represented by full unsteady routing.
units.failure: 把水團行程當洪峰行程可能錯估訊號到達時間，忽略洪泛區儲存則可能漏掉展寬；若再把遙測延遲算進物理波速，模型參數會失去明確意義。~Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening. Folding telemetry delay into physical celerity additionally gives model parameters an ambiguous and misleading meaning.
units.misconception: 洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。~A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity.
units.practice: 用同一河長分別算水團和運動波行程，清楚標出兩者差異。加入假設通訊延遲後，將物理傳遞與資訊到達分開列帳，避免混成一個校正係數。~Calculate parcel and kinematic-wave travel for one reach and label their difference. Add a hypothetical communication delay, keeping physical travel and information arrival in separate ledgers instead of combining them into one calibration factor.

units.anchor: 堤頂餘高與高程預留~Crest margin and elevation allowances
units.title: 堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證~Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分洪道兩側堤頂到水面的幾何差只是起點，沉陷、波浪、模型不確定度與局部水位抬升都會消耗可用餘量。各項預留需要一致定義，不能重複扣已包含在設計水位中的因素；同一標準餘高也不能代替滲流、邊坡和出口安全分析，因為未越頂仍可能發生其他失效。本例只扣指定沉陷量，未加入波浪或其他必要項，也不是任何規範的所需餘高；輸入皆採相同高程基準。~The geometric difference between crest and water surface is only a starting point. Settlement, waves, model uncertainty and local setup consume available margin. Allowances need consistent definitions to avoid deducting factors already included in design stage. A crest margin also does not replace seepage, slope or outlet analysis, because failure can occur without overtopping. The example deducts specified settlement only, omitting waves and other necessary terms. It is not a code-required freeboard, and all elevations use one datum.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堤頂Zc=102.5 m、計算水面Zw=101.7 m、預留沉陷s=0.20 m，剩餘幾何餘量F=Zc−Zw−s=0.60 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume crest Zc=102.5 m, computed surface Zw=101.7 m and settlement allowance s=0.20 m. Remaining geometric margin F=Zc−Zw−s=0.60 m.
units.verify: 沿線測量最低堤頂與接合點，確認水位和沉陷使用同一基準及時間。把波浪、模型誤差與沉陷來源逐項列出，檢查哪些已含在設計水位，並另外評估未越頂的失效模式。~Survey minimum crest and transitions along the route, aligning water level and settlement by datum and time. List wave, model-error and settlement sources, check which are already included in stage, and independently assess failure mechanisms that do not require overtopping.
units.failure: 只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。~An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons. Declaring complete safety from positive geometric margin overlooks internal erosion, slope instability and foundation problems below overtopping conditions.
units.misconception: 只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。~If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail.
units.practice: 用三個沿線堤頂與水面資料找最小餘量，加入局部沉陷後重新排序。將越頂和非越頂失效列成平行檢查，說明高程表無法回答的土工問題。~Find the minimum margin from three crest/surface pairs and reorder them after local settlement. List overtopping and non-overtopping checks in parallel, explaining geotechnical questions that an elevation table cannot answer.

units.anchor: 分洪泥砂與河床演變~Diversion sediment and bed evolution
units.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證~Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。長期淤積可能抬高入口或減少渠容，沖刷則可能威脅基礎；泥砂體積帳需要區分固體體積與含孔隙床體積，不能把水量分流比例直接當成泥砂分流比例。本例採均勻床面變化、固定孔隙率與固體體積輸砂率，只表示區段平均沉積；未預測局部沖刷或粒徑分選。~Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average. Aggradation can raise the inlet or reduce channel space, while scour threatens foundations. A sediment-volume ledger distinguishes solids from porous bed volume and must not equate water diversion fraction with sediment diversion fraction. The example assumes uniform bed change, fixed porosity and solid-volume transport rates. It gives reach-average deposition only, excluding local scour and size sorting.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m. Mean Δz=(Qsin−Qsout)t/[(1−p)BL]=0.0015 m.
units.verify: 將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。檢查入口附近和彎道的局部變化，並讓更新後河床回饋到水理模型，而不是永久固定初始斷面。~Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions. Inspect localized changes near the inlet and bends, and feed the updated bed back into hydraulics instead of retaining the initial channel geometry indefinitely despite sediment evolution.
units.failure: 漏掉孔隙率會低估沉積床體積，區段平均很小也可能掩蓋入口沙洲；固定河床模型若用於多年規劃，可能高估未來分洪能力或漏掉局部基礎沖刷。~Omitting porosity understates deposited bed volume, and a small reach average can conceal an inlet bar. A fixed-bed model used for long-term planning may overstate future diversion or miss local foundation scour.
units.misconception: 分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。~Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed.
units.practice: 用相同固體量比較兩種孔隙率的床面升幅，再把沉積集中於入口短段。說明平均高程與局部高程對水理模型有何不同影響，規劃重複測量位置。~Compare bed rise at two porosities for the same solid volume, then concentrate deposition in a short inlet reach. Explain how mean and local elevations affect hydraulics differently and choose repeat-survey locations accordingly.

units.anchor: 非恆定時間步與驗證~Unsteady time step and verification
units.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證~Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。庫朗數可作顯式淺水波離散的尺度檢查，但不同求解器的穩定與準確條件不同，不能把一個數值當所有軟體保證；網格、時間步和邊界敏感度應與量測驗證一同檢查。本例使用矩形水深的重力波速與順流速度相加，指定目標庫朗數只為示範；隱式求解器或其他格式需依自身文件判斷。~Flood routing must resolve propagation between cells; a large time step can cause oscillation, numerical diffusion or missed brief control. Courant number offers a scale check for explicit shallow-water discretization, but stability and accuracy differ among solvers. One number is not a universal software guarantee; grid, time-step and boundary sensitivity require checking alongside observations. The example adds rectangular-channel gravity-wave speed to downstream velocity for an illustrative target Courant number. Implicit solvers and other schemes require their own documented criteria.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δx=50 m、V=2 m/s、h=2 m、g=9.81 m/s²、C=0.80，Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δx=50 m, V=2 m/s, h=2 m, g=9.81 m/s² and C=0.80. Time step Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s.
units.verify: 確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。保留水量殘差及局部振盪位置，再用未參與校正的事件驗證，不能只以計算成功結束當作通過。~Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time. Retain balance residuals and locations of oscillation, then validate against an event excluded from calibration rather than treating successful program completion as proof.
units.failure: 穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。~A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. Changing physical roughness merely to achieve numerical stability gives that parameter a false physical interpretation.
units.misconception: 模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。~A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions.
units.practice: 製作粗細兩組網格與時間步的比較表，分開列穩定性、守恆與峰值差異。指出哪種差異需要改善數值解析度，哪種可能需要重新調查實際邊界。~Compare coarse and fine grids and steps, listing stability, conservation and peak differences separately. Identify differences requiring numerical refinement versus those suggesting renewed investigation of the physical boundary conditions.

example: 敏感度固定矩形渠寬20 m、水深2 m及能坡0.0004，只把曼寧糙率由0.030增至0.036 s/m^(1/3)。在這個固定幾何與能坡比較下，流量由37.49降至31.24 m³/s，減少16.67%。這不是說洪水流量固定時水位會同樣減少；若入流必須通過，水深與回水曲線會重新調整。植被、沉積與橋孔還可能同時改變有效幾何，所以實務敏感度應逐項隔離再合併情境，並檢查下游邊界是否仍適用。~Hold rectangular width at 20 m, depth at 2 m and energy slope at 0.0004 while increasing Manning roughness from 0.030 to 0.036 s/m^(1/3). Under this fixed-geometry and fixed-slope comparison, flow falls from 37.49 to 31.24 m³/s, a 16.67% reduction. This does not mean stage falls proportionally when a fixed flood inflow must pass; depth and backwater must then adjust. Vegetation, deposits and bridge openings may also change effective geometry. Practical sensitivity work should isolate those effects before combining scenarios and recheck the receiving boundary throughout. Field observations should distinguish vegetation resistance from an actual reduction of channel area.
history: 紅河原分洪道於1962至1968年興建，曼尼托巴官方資料說明低水位時入口門檻和洪水時主河與繞道互動；擴建投資於2005年開始。元朗排洪繞道於2003年開工、2006年完成，把部分逕流帶到錦田河下游，並結合濕地與低流量管理。環保署2017年水理手冊提供管渠、控制構造和演算方法背景。本課僅借用已核對的歷史與功能，未宣稱兩處工程採用所列理想堰或假設糙率。~The original Red River Floodway was constructed from 1962 to 1968; Manitoba describes the low-stage inlet threshold and interaction of river and bypass during floods, with expansion investment beginning in 2005. Yuen Long began construction in 2003 and was completed in 2006, diverting part of runoff toward lower Kam Tin while integrating wetland and low-flow management. EPA’s 2017 hydraulic manual supplies routing and control-method context. Only verified history and function are used; neither project is claimed to employ the lesson’s ideal weir or assumed roughness.

timeline.event: 紅河原分洪道施工，形成城市外繞排洪路徑。~Original Red River Floodway construction creates a bypass route around the city.
元朗排洪繞道完成，連結分洪與河道生態配置。~Yuen Long Bypass Floodway is completed with diversion and ecological elements.
環保署發布水理參考手冊，提供流量控制演算背景。~EPA publishes its hydraulic reference manual supporting control and routing methods.

Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction.

Manning Q=37.49 m³/s.

Kinetic-head increase Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m.
